text:
ashley: FYI I tried to spin up 8 x A10G in West Europe for the new performance test pool and hit quota limits on both vCPUs and subnet IPs.
patrick: ugh, which quotas exactly? vCPU per subscription or per region?
maria: subnet IPs are usually the blocker — Azure defaults to small subnet sizes on our template :/ 
ashley: vCPUs per region limit = 100 currently, need +64. Subnet is /28 so only 13 usable IPs, need ~32 per GPU node group. Opened a support case: Case# 2100123456. infra-bot: Created support case 2100123456 for subscription 0a1b-2c3d. Assigned to azure-quotas team. Expected response window: 24-72h. :robot_face:
kai: can you drop the subscription id & region here so I can link it to the account onboarding ticket?
ashley: sub: 0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789, region: westeurope, desired timeline: asap this week for testing.
patrick: tagging @azure-support — we need escalation if it stalls. The perf tests are gated on this.
azure-support: Hi team — I've got Case# 2100123456. Initial triage done, quota team requested justification and planned timeline. Please provide estimated node count, storage requirements, and whether spot instances acceptable. Escalation to quota engineering queued (ref: ESC-4521). ETA 48h.
maria: quick answers — node count 8 (will scale to 12 in next sprint), non-spot for baseline (spot for dev), storage: 1TB managed disk per node, nic count 2 per node.
patrick: note — NICs and IPs: need 16 IPs per subnet to allow k8s pod IPs and kube-proxy. Ideally three subnets per cluster (mgmt/control/data).
ashley: azure-support — added details in support portal and linking our cost approval doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/infra/azure-gpu-requests
azure-support: Received, filing for quota increase: vCPU +64 (target 164), subnet increase: expand to /26 for the node pool subnets, NIC quota +16. Case updated 2100123456. Escalation ESC-4521 active. 
kai: short term workaround: can we reuse existing bigger subnets in the tenant (non-prod) and isolate via NSGs until quota clears? If so we can run smoke tests tomorrow.
maria: also we could try A10G -> NCasT4_v3 for part of the fleet to reduce vCPU pressure. Perf delta is ~15% but cheaper.
patrick: cost note — if we split across types, ensure we pin model shards to A10G nodes for latency-critical tests.
ashley: agreed. I'll try subnet reuse tomorrow and kick off a scaled-down run (4 nodes) to validate infra plumbing. Will update here when quota case changes.
infra-bot: Support case 2100123456 updated by azure-support. Status: Escalated. Next ETA: 2024-11-05 14:00 UTC. Reference ESC-4521.
azure-support: Quick update — quota team requested subscription-level billing contact to approve temporary burst. Please confirm who can sign off.
patrick: i'll sign for this sprint (patrick@redwood.ai). go ahead and add to the case.
ashley: thanks. pinging once we get approval or if we hit a hard stop. :thumbsup:
kai: noted. adding runbook step to the cluster bootstrap to pick fallback instance type if A10G not available.
maria: nice. can someone add the az cli snippet for updating subnet size here for ops playbook?
patrick: sure — snippet: ```bash
# expand subnet (requires proper permissions)
az network vnet subnet update \
  --resource-group rg-gpu-westeu \
  --vnet-name vnet-gpu-westeu \
  --name nodes-subnet \
  --address-prefixes 10.4.0.0/26
```
ashley: perfect. saved to runbook. last note — if we don't see approval in 48h escalate to account rep (srz@azure).
